# The Dairy Doctor: Advanced Dairy Diagnostics & Consulting, LLC

> A mail-in veterinary diagnostic lab and herd health consulting practice run by Dr. Glenn Pearson, DVM, in Frederic, Wisconsin. BioPRYN blood pregnancy testing for cattle, bison, goats and sheep, BVD PI testing for cattle and bison, and herd health consulting.

The practice opened in 1999 as Dairy Pharm Services and in 2005 became the first BioPRYN affiliate lab east of the Rockies. Every plate is read by the lab's veterinarian. Samples that reach the lab by Wednesday are reported Thursday by email, fax or phone, whichever you mark on the form. Tests run Monday through Thursday. The lab is staffed Monday to Friday, 8 a.m. to 4 p.m. Central. The lab is closed to visitors for biosecurity; samples come by mail. There is no online ordering: farms draw their own samples, fill in the paper submission form and mail the box.

Mail and samples: 362 310th Avenue, Frederic, WI 54837. Phone (715) 653-2201. Fax (715) 653-4301. Email info@dairydoctor.com.

## Tests

- [Pregnancy testing](https://dairydoctor.com/pregtest.html): BioPRYN blood test. Cows and bison from 28 days after breeding, virgin heifers from 25 days, goats and sheep from 30 days; cows at least 90 days after calving. Prices are on this page.
- [BVD PI testing](https://dairydoctor.com/bvdtest.html): ear notch or blood, cattle and bison only, shipped cold. Prices are on this page.
- [How results are read](https://dairydoctor.com/results.html): pregnant, open and recheck, what the veterinarian adds, and the limits of the test.

## Your herd

- [Beef and bison herds](https://dairydoctor.com/beef.html): testing at the chute or handling system, by mail.
- [Goats and sheep](https://dairydoctor.com/goats.html): pregnancy testing from 30 days after breeding, jugular-drawn.
- [Herd health consulting](https://dairydoctor.com/consulting.html): records review, Dairy Comp 305 records consulting, preventive programs, biosecurity design, and Johne's, Leukosis and Mycoplasma monitoring.

## Sending samples

- [How to tail bleed a cow](https://dairydoctor.com/tailbleeding.html): step-by-step tail-vein draw, and the jugular draw for goats and sheep.
- [Packing and shipping](https://dairydoctor.com/shipping_test.html): packing steps, forms, supplies and a ship-by planner.
- [Common questions](https://dairydoctor.com/faq.html): timing, samples, results and payment.
